description: Convert any amount between 30+ world currencies with live exchange rates. Pick source and target currencies, convert instantly, and see the rate and last update date.

faqs.a: Live rates are fetched from /api/rates. If the fetch fails you will see a clear error message and the last cached result stays visible.
faqs.q: Where do the exchange rates come from?

faqs.a: The converted amount is updated whenever the rate loads. Fetched rates are cached per base currency so switching back is instant.
The USD -> PKR rate shown comes straight from the live feed, so it reflects the latest available market rate.
faqs.q: What is the current USD to PKR rate?

howto: Choose the From and To currencies.
Tap Convert (or just change the amount) to see the result.
Use Swap to flip the currencies; rates are cached per base currency.
title: Currency Converter
